privacy_policy.title: Privacy & Terms
privacy_policy.hero_subtitle: Your data is safe, your rights are protected 🛡️
privacy_policy.intro_title: Your privacy is our top priority
privacy_policy.intro_desc: We believe trust is the foundation of healthcare. This policy aims to clearly explain how we collect and use your data with complete transparency, to ensure a safe and reliable experience that complies with approved regulations.
privacy_policy.disclaimer_purpose: Purpose: A technical intermediary for scheduling appointments and facilitating communication.
privacy_policy.disclaimer_advice: Not Medical Advice: Content is not a substitute for in-person consultation.
privacy_policy.disclaimer_emergency: Emergency: Please go directly to a hospital in case of emergencies.
privacy_policy.disclaimer_liability: Liability: Full medical responsibility lies with the doctor/clinic.
privacy_policy.privacy_item_1_content:
• User Data: Name, phone number, email address.
• Medical Data: Appointment communications, uploaded medical history (for doctor's review only).
• Geographic Location: To identify clinics near you (with your consent).
privacy_policy.privacy_item_2_content:
• To organize and book appointments between patients and clinics.
• To send appointment reminders.
• To improve service quality and user experience.
privacy_policy.privacy_item_3_content:
• We do not sell your data to any advertising parties.
• Your medical data is shared only with the clinic you choose to book with.
privacy_policy.privacy_item_4_content: We use advanced encryption technologies to protect your medical records and personal information from unauthorized access.
privacy_policy.privacy_item_5_content: Users have the right to delete their account and data at any time through the app settings.

chatbot.quick_book: 📅 How do I book an appointment?
chatbot.welcome_message:
Welcome to our smart clinic assistant 👋

⚠️ Important note: I am an AI assistant for general medical questions and clinic services. My information may be inaccurate and never replaces consulting a specialist doctor.
chatbot.image_received:
I received the image 📷.
You can send your text question now so it can be passed to the backend assistant system.
chatbot.image_analysis:
I received the image 📷.
Based on the initial analysis, there appears to be skin redness. I recommend booking an appointment with a dermatologist for an accurate examination.
chatbot.fallback_message: Your message has been received. The system could not generate a smart reply right now, and the response will rely on the available backend data.
chatbot.non_medical: Sorry, I am a specialized medical bot 🩺. I can only answer questions related to health or clinic services.
chatbot.book_response: To book an appointment, use the Quick Booking button on the home page, or tell me the specialty you need and I will help you.
chatbot.hours_response: The support team is available daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM 🕙.
chatbot.location_response: We are located in Riyadh, King Fahd Road, building 102.
chatbot.headache_response: Wishing you safety! Headaches may be caused by stress or lack of sleep. We recommend drinking water and resting. If the pain continues, please book an appointment with an internal medicine doctor.
chatbot.default_response: Thank you for your inquiry. I will forward this question to a receptionist for a more accurate response, or you can contact us directly 📞.
